verdict.rationale: Anrok's AI Atlas is described as a built-in assistant that answers sales-tax questions with reasoning grounded in the customer's own transactions, registrations, filings, and certificates (anrok-docs-15), which is a genuine built-in AI assistant experience, and Headless Tax also references handing tax tasks 'to your agents' (anrok-docs-16, anrok-docs-30). However, evidence is limited to marketing copy with no detail on the scope of delegable tasks, no hands-on/independent corroboration, and it reads more as a Q&A/insights tool than a broad task-delegation agent. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence of the assistant executing multi-step tasks, documentation of its action capabilities beyond answering questions, and third-party validation.
